Pretty good. I have tried a number of sleep apps and this is definitely a favorite but there are some frustrations. First, the positives: I love the unique features like the cool, mesmerizing videos and the bedtime stories, and that it includes meditations - even ones that aren’t sleep related. It seems they’re trying to help ease anxiety, overall, to help you sleep better at night. I really love the large number of sounds (that are all available at once - no additional purchases to unlock some, like in other apps) and especially that you can mix sounds and save your favorite mixes. Only one real negative, so far, but it’s a big one: with a number of the sounds, you can definitely hear the restart of the loop. The basic fan sound even just stops for about 3 seconds every 15 seconds or so. The pink and white noises also have looping restart glitches you can clearly hear. When someone is already struggling to sleep, something like that is very noticeable! It’s really annoying, particularly when I have free apps that don’t do that and this one is $60 every year! But everything else is good, at this point. :)
